body:
Buying several units at once can reduce the price per device, cut the number of shipments and save you the flat shipping fee, and it is worth doing within limits. Bulk buying is not a free lunch: liquid and batteries age, flavors go stale and a stack of a flavor you stop enjoying is wasted money. This guide explains where bulk buying saves money, what is worth buying in quantity, what to avoid overbuying, how the free-shipping threshold and the crypto and gift card discount fit in, how to plan a mixed order, how to store stock and how retailers can buy wholesale. It is written for adults aged 21 and over. Nicotine is addictive, and this is not advice to use more.

## Where bulk saves money
- **Per-unit price:** multi-packs and larger orders often cost less per item. Many of our listings offer a 5-pack bundle, and the price updates when you choose it above the Add to Cart button.
- **Shipping:** orders over our free-shipping threshold ship free, so combining purchases saves the flat fee. See the [shipping policy](/shipping/) and [minimum order and free shipping explained](/blog/minimum-order-and-free-shipping-explained/).
- **Discounts:** cryptocurrency and gift cards save 10% on the subtotal, which grows with the order.
- **Fewer deliveries:** every delivery needs an adult signature, so fewer drop-offs is easier to manage.
- **Planning:** a stock on the shelf means you never run out.

## What to buy in quantity
Disposables and nicotine pouches have stable shelf lives when stored correctly. E-liquid also keeps for a long time if stored cool and dark. These are good candidates for bulk. Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/), [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [nicotine pouches](/shop/nic-pouches/). Replacement coils and pods are also worth buying in packs for devices you use regularly, because a spare avoids downtime.

## What not to overbuy
Flavors you have not tried. Buy one first, then scale up. Opened or used products cannot be returned, so an untried flavor in bulk is a risk. Also avoid buying more than you can store properly; heat shortens the life of liquid and batteries. Avoid buying products near their best-by date, and avoid filling your cart just to hit a threshold with things you will not use.

## A worked example
Suppose you use one 25,000-puff device a month, at $17.99. Buying one at a time, you pay $17.99 plus shipping each month, and you must reach the $100 minimum, so you would be buying more than one anyway. Suppose instead you buy six devices at once: $107.94 before discount. If you pay by crypto, the 10% discount takes it to $97.15, which is below the $100 minimum, so you would need a little more. Add a seventh device: $125.93, discount $12.59, total $113.34 plus $15 shipping, so $128.34 for seven. That is about $18.33 per device, including shipping, and you have seven months of supply. If you push to $222 or more before discount, shipping is free. The point is to plan around the minimum, the threshold and the discount.

## Using the free-shipping threshold well
Free shipping applies to orders of $200 or more after discount and before tax. If you pay by crypto or gift card, you need a subtotal of about $222.23 to reach $200 after the 10% discount. If you pay by an app, you need $200. Check your cart total against the line before checkout. If you are close, adding a small item you will use may save the shipping fee. See [the 10% crypto and gift card discount](/blog/crypto-discount-how-it-works/).

## Mixing flavors
A mixed order lets you rotate flavors, which many users prefer, because taste fatigue is real. Instead of six of one flavor, buy three of two, or two of three. That keeps each fresh, and you can adjust next time. Check your cart total against the free shipping line before checkout.

## Storage reminder
Keep all products away from children and pets and from direct heat. Nicotine is addictive. Store devices cool and dry, upright, in their packaging until you need them; see [how to store disposable vapes](/blog/how-to-store-disposable-vapes/). Store e-liquid cool and dark; see [how to store e-liquid](/blog/how-to-store-e-liquid/). Store pouches sealed; see [how to store nicotine pouches](/blog/how-to-store-nicotine-pouches/). Label dates, and use the oldest first. Check stock monthly.

## Business buyers
If you resell, our [wholesale page](/wholesale/) offers volume pricing and a dedicated contact. Our [wholesale ordering guide](/blog/wholesale-ordering-guide/) walks through the process, and [how to become a wholesale customer](/blog/how-to-become-a-wholesale-customer/) explains the steps. Retailers are responsible for their own licensing and compliance.

## Risks of bulk buying
- **Flavor fatigue.** You may tire of a flavor before you finish a stack.
- **Aging.** Liquid and batteries lose quality over time.
- **Storage.** Heat and humidity damage stock.
- **Money tied up.** A large order is cash you cannot use elsewhere.
- **Temptation to use more.** Nicotine is addictive, and a large stock can encourage heavier use. Keep your habits in check.
- **Changes in rules.** Local rules can change, and a product you stocked may become restricted.

## A planning routine
Estimate your monthly use. Choose how many months of supply you are comfortable holding, usually one to three. Buy that amount in a mix of flavors. Store it properly. Review each month, and adjust the next order. This routine avoids waste and keeps your spending steady.

## Common mistakes
- **Buying a bundle of an untried flavor.**
- **Ignoring best-by dates.**
- **Storing stock in a hot place.**
- **Chasing a threshold with items you will not use.**
- **Leaving stock where children or pets can reach it.**

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### How much should I buy at once?
Enough for one to three months of your own use, and no more than you can store properly.

### Do bundles always save money?
Per device, usually. Compare the total and your use.

### Can I return bulk items?
Unopened items in original packaging within 30 days, with an RMA and a 15% restocking fee. Opened or used items cannot be returned. See [refund and return policy explained](/blog/refund-and-return-policy-explained/).

### Is shipping cheaper for bigger orders?
Orders of $200 or more after discount ship free. Below that, a flat $15 applies.

### Are there wholesale prices for individuals?
Wholesale is for registered retailers. Individuals can use bundles and discounts.

## Shop
Browse [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/) and [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## A step-by-step bulk plan
1. Estimate your use for one month.
2. Decide how many months of supply you are comfortable with, usually one to three.
3. List the products and quantities.
4. Check the total against the $100 minimum and the $200 free-shipping line.
5. Choose your payment method, noting the 10% discount for crypto and gift cards.
6. Check best-by dates and storage space.
7. Place the order, and record the date.

## How much storage you need
A month of disposables takes very little room. A few bottles of liquid fit on a shelf. A few cans of pouches fit in a drawer. For a larger stock, use a closed cabinet or a lockable box. Keep stock cool, dry and away from sunlight, and keep it away from children and pets. If you do not have a good place to store it, buy less.

## Combining with friends
Some adults share an order to reach a threshold. If you do, agree who pays what and who receives the parcel. Remember that each order has one delivery address, one payment method and one adult signature, and that products are for adults only. Do not share with anyone under 21. Keep the invoice for your records.

## When bulk is not worth it
If you are not sure you will like a product, if you are trying to reduce your use or if storage is a problem, buy small. Savings from bulk are real, but they are not worth it if the stock goes stale or encourages you to use more than you intended. Nicotine is addictive, and your habits matter more than a discount.

## Frequently asked questions about bulk orders
### Can I split a bulk order across payment methods?
Please choose one method per order. Contact us before ordering if you have a special situation.

### Will a bulk order take longer to ship?
Processing is 24 to 72 business hours for any order, though large orders may be reviewed for accuracy, which can add a little time.

### Is there a limit on quantity?
Each line can be up to 99 units in the cart. For larger quantities, contact us about wholesale.

### Does a bulk order change how the parcel arrives?
No. It ships with adult signature like any other order, possibly in more than one carton.

### Can I mix products in a bulk order?
Yes. Mix disposables, liquids, pods and pouches, and check the total against the thresholds.

### What if one item in a bulk order is damaged?
Photograph it and the invoice and email us. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

### A final check before you order
Look at your cart, and ask: will I use all of this before it ages? Do I have somewhere cool and secure to keep it? Is the total where I want it relative to the $100 minimum and the $200 line? Am I choosing flavors I know? If the answers are yes, go ahead. If not, trim the order.
